title: Engine roll has the opposite sign of a solver's image roll
summary: S.camera roll is applied as cam.rotateZ(roll) after lookAt; a solver's roll rotates image coordinates. Engine roll = -(solver roll). Rendering +0.114 tilted the image 13 deg the wrong way.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: S.camera([{ t: 0, p, l, fov, roll: -solverRoll }])   // dig: solver .114 -> roll -.114

doc.when: Any solved or measured camera with roll.
doc.avoid: Copying the solver's roll straight into S.camera.
gotchas: Verify with a marker proof right after the solve.

problem.symptom: The render is tilted the wrong way (about twice the roll) against the reference.
problem.cause: The engine rotates the camera after lookAt; the solver rotates image coordinates: opposite signs.
problem.detect: Marker proof: glowing spheres at 5 landmarks land off their predicted pixels in a rotating pattern.
